How to Protect Sensitive Skin from Peeling During Winter

During winter, skin with sensitivity can get irritated and become very dry and flaky. However, to make sure that skin remains healthy and hydrated during winter, it is important to take good care of it from the very beginning. For this purpose, it is important to use a mild and unscented skin cleanser and always avoid the use of hot water because it causes drying of the skin by removing its natural oils.
Switch to rich creams instead of lotions and look for ingredients like ceramides, glycerine, hyaluronic acid, shea butter, and liquid paraffin to strengthen the skin barrier and lock in moisture. Don’t skip sunscreen—UV rays can still damage your skin even in winter. When stepping out in windy weather, cover your face with a scarf and avoid harsh or frequent exfoliation, especially if your skin is already peeling.
Stay hydrated by drinking enough water and include salads, sprouts, and green veggies in your diet along with healthy fats to nourish your skin from within. Dry Skin vs Dehydrated Skin – Know the Difference

Many people think dry skin and dehydrated skin are the same, but they are different. Dry skin is a skin type. It means your skin does not produce enough natural oil, so it often feels rough, itchy, and flaky. Dehydrated skin is a condition. It happens when your skin lacks water, which makes it look dull, tight, and tired, even if your skin is oily.
Dry skin needs more moisture and gentle skincare products. Dehydrated skin needs more hydration from inside and outside, like drinking enough water and using hydrating serums. When you use the wrong products, the problem can get worse.

featured_reviews.review_text:
### **Disclaimer:**

I didn’t go through with treatment because I prefer being treated by an actual doctor, not someone who seems more focused on squeezing money out of patients, especially those who may not be financially well-off. And I say that with full awareness of what “poor patients” truly means.

**My Experience:**

I’m new to the city, so I searched online for a dermatologist nearby who had good reviews. Strangely enough, this particular doctor came up as one of the top-rated in the area. The appointment process was smooth, the lady who answered the phone was polite and scheduled me for the next day, which is the day of review.

And of course, like it’s becoming all too common these days, the doctor didn’t show up on time despite the appointment.

When the doctor finally arrived, I was called in. I explained that I had a skin rash and also an issue on the scalp, both seemingly related. Without even hearing me out properly, she immediately declared, “That’s two different problems,” and proceeded to say she charges separately for each issue. I was stunned at how transactional her tone was like I’d committed a crime by showing up with two symptoms.

At that moment, I started questioning the setup. Is this how some doctors in this city operate, charging patients separately for every concern just to make more money? I even thought to myself: if I were okay paying this kind of fee, I would’ve gone to a more qualified dermatologist. Someone with a proper masters degree  and specialization not someone who’s only done a diploma course or vocational training in dermatology.

My intention was simple: to consult a regular, affordable doctor for a rash, not an overpriced cosmetologist. Ironically, this doctor was charging *more* than the high-end specialists do. I told her, “Even though I can afford it, I refuse to waste money like this,” and walked out.

### **Why I’m Sharing This:**

It’s important to understand the nature of your health problem and how much it should realistically cost to treat it. At the end of the day, it’s *your* health and *your* money. I’m glad I learned something today, and I hope this helps others stay cautious and informed too. Also please let the doctor mention her qualifications.

Absolutely! Sunscreen isn’t just for preventing tanning—it helps protect your skin from harmful UV rays that break down collagen and elastin, the proteins responsible for keeping your skin firm and youthful.

Daily sunscreen can help reduce the risk of:
✔️ Fine lines & wrinkles
✔️ Sun spots & pigmentation
✔️ Uneven skin tone
✔️ Premature skin ageing

Healthy, youthful skin starts with one simple habit: wear sunscreen every day, even on cloudy days.

The Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser is an advanced dermatology treatment that precisely targets excess pigment while minimizing damage to the surrounding skin. It can help improve pigmentation, melasma, sunspots, freckles, acne marks, and tattoo removal with minimal downtime.

At NM Skin & Cosmetology Clinic, Dr. Nimesh Mehta offers personalized laser treatments based on your skin type and concerns to help you achieve clearer, healthier-looking skin.

Does your fungal infection keep coming back?

Recurring fungal infections are often caused by incomplete treatment, self-medication, or conditions that allow the fungus to thrive, such as warm and moist skin. Simply treating the visible rash may not always address the underlying infection.

A proper diagnosis and the right treatment plan can help clear the infection and reduce the chances of it returning.

At NM Skin & Cosmetology Clinic, Dr. Nimesh Mehta provides expert diagnosis and personalised treatment for fungal skin infections.

Many people think acne and acne scars are the same, but they require different treatments. Active acne appears as pimples, redness, and inflammation, while acne scars are the marks or depressions left behind after acne heals. At NM Skin & Cosmetology Clinic, Dr. Nimesh Mehta offers personalized treatment plans for both active acne and acne scars using advanced dermatological procedures such as medical acne management, chemical peels, microneedling (Dermapen), and fractional CO₂ laser resurfacing. featured_reviews.name: Simran Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of THE best dermatologist I have been to. Have been going to her since I was in college and the treatments have helped improve my skin so much. I used to face acne issues and haven't experience and breakout since I started consulting with Dr Dimple.
The staff is very helpful and they make sure you are comfortable with all the treatments and understand what is being put on your face and help you go through the benefits of the products used!
Would recommend everyone to visit her for sure.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Simran, that's a really sweet feedback, I am so glad I could help you out with your skin issues.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been going to Dr dimple for years now. She has the most effective, simple and doable line of treatment. It's always been effective for me. She is very approachable, warm and understanding to help you design your treatment to suit you. She is also updated with the new technologies, so always helps with the latest yet effective treatment. Thank you Dr!
